status: generated; local exploratory validation only; not organizer-certified
data_scope: official train.csv and test.csv; sample_submission.csv read only for schema and ID/order validation

blend.prior_model_views: 50% within-test rank of Phase 33/34 probability average + 50% within-test rank of clean CatBoost

pairwise_ranker.pair_construction: mean; 8 sampled pairs per sample in one global applicant group per training fold
pairwise_ranker.feature_matrix: Phase 33 key-frequency matrix fit on each training fold

blend.final_rule: 90% rank of the fixed TE20 candidate + 10% rank of the pairwise ranker; the pairwise test rank is averaged across fold models
blend.weights: fixed and documented; no row-specific routing or prediction edits

validation.type: five-fold stratified OOF using seed 20261113; folds shared across components
validation.weight_selection_caveat: The TE20 baseline weight was selected on repeatedly examined labels. The 10% pairwise addition was pre-specified from prior pairwise screens, but this comparison is still exploratory and subject to model-selection optimism. The leaderboard score is unknown until submitted by the user.

rule_controls.label_transfer: none; only smoothed category target statistics from the official TARGET column, cross-fitted within training partitions
rule_controls.train_test_statistical_pooling: none; row-wise features are built separately, CatBoost train/test frames remain separate, and encoders/counts/target maps fit only on training partitions
rule_controls.test_set_perturbation: passed; changing/reordering test covariates did not change sampled training or validation matrices
rule_controls.validation_label_perturbation: passed; changing only outer-validation labels did not change the fold-local target encodings
rule_controls.test_set_use: model inference only; sample file used only to validate output schema and order
rule_controls.reproducibility: fixed seeds; source/data hashes and package versions recorded
